name: interview-scorecard
description: Turn several interviewers' scorecards into one fair, weighted ranking. Write the criteria once in Markdown — weights, a 1–5 (or any) scale, the hire bar and anchor descriptions for each level — and drop in the score sheets (Excel or CSV, one row per candidate × interviewer; column names are matched to the criteria, aliases allowed). It averages each candidate per criterion and by weight, suggests 建议录用 / 待定 / 需讨论 / 不建议, and catches what a spreadsheet won't: typos like 45 for 4.5, missing scores, duplicate scorecards, interviewers who disagree by two points or more, a “strong yes” with failing scores, extreme scores without evidence, and lenient or strict interviewers (with optional calibration). Exports a ranking workbook, a one-page PDF scorecard per candidate with every interviewer's scores and comments, and a blank printable scorecard with the anchors. No account or API keys; everything stays on your computer.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把多位面试官的评分表汇总成一份公平的加权排名。用 Markdown 写一次评分维度——权重、1–5 分（或任意分制）、录用线，以及每个分数档的行为描述——再放入评分表（Excel 或 CSV，一行一位候选人 × 一位面试官；列名自动对应维度，支持别名）。它按维度和权重给每位候选人算平均分，给出 建议录用 / 待定 / 需讨论 / 不建议，并发现表格发现不了的问题：把 4.5 打成 45、漏打分、重复的评分表、同一维度面试官相差 2 分以上、“强烈推荐”却分数不及格、打了极端分却没写依据、面试官打分偏松或偏严（可选校准）。导出排名表、每位候选人一页的 PDF 评分卡（含每位面试官的分数和评语）和带评分描述的空白评分表。不用登录，无需 API 密钥，数据都在本机。
